build_constant_noise_gp_vfe: build a Gaussian Process VFE module with constant noise assumption for variational free energy computation
build_varying_noise_gp_vfe: build a Gaussian Process VFE module with varying noise per data point for variational free energy computation
run_solve_optimal_mean: run the optimal mean solver using Cholesky triangular solve on kernel matrices and observations
run_constant_noise_forward: run the constant noise forward pass to compute negative log marginal likelihood with scalar variance
run_varying_noise_forward: run the varying noise forward pass to compute negative log marginal likelihood with per-point variance
